title: [UI Tests] Treat warnings as errors in module UI test projects

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Source-only inspection confirms cached direct and immediate test-framework dependencies, but does not yet establish a complete offline transitive restore closure. Both the Advanced Paste UI-test project and its shared automation dependency lack restore assets. The candidate test executables are absent; the available winapp alias is an unverified zero-byte reparse point rather than a verified runnable executable. Static source inspection estimates 61 cases, not a discovered or executed count. The measured status remains zero of 23 projects built and 22 not run. Dependency closure and the actual runtime executable are being resolved before any separately authorized restore or validation.
